title: Adapter capability document v1
description: 00 §10 adapter protocol capability document (04.7.1-T1.1). The server rejects an incompatible protocol.major; supports is extensible — flags the server does not know are recorded verbatim in adapter_capability.supports and never evaluated (04.7.1 AC3). capture_control: false declares that the adapter cannot honour the run-create configuration document (contracts/adapter/config.v1.json), so its runs carry the capture_uncontrolled label (T97, AC7); an absent capture_control means the configuration document must be honoured. The document is untrusted input capped at 16 KiB. See contracts/README.md for the *.vN.json versioning rule.

version.description: Exact engine version; carried here and (V2) pinned in the immutable JobSpec with the image digest — runners never resolve 'latest' at run time (D8)

capture_control.description: false = the adapter cannot honour contracts/adapter/config.v1.json at run create, so the run carries the capture_uncontrolled label (T97, AC7); absent = the configuration document is delivered and must be honoured

additionalProperties.description: A support flag this server does not know: ignored, never evaluated, and stored verbatim (04.7.1 AC3)

mode.description: ingest_only results are viewable but not gate-eligible unless the manifest is proven complete (00 §10)
